newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - SoundView bullish on IBM.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SoundView bullish on IBM.

text.p: SoundView Financial Group analyst Gary Helmig said he made positive comments on International Business Machines Corp, after some investors voiced concerns about the impact of the stronger dollar against the German mark in the third quarter.

-- Helmig said he is maintaining his estimate of $1.45 a share and said he expects current exchange rates to have a negative impact of about four percent on revenue growth in the third quarter. He also maintains a buy rating on IBM.
-- He also said he maintains his estimates of $1.42 for the second quarter, which IBM will report on Monday.
-- IBM shares were up three to 100-5/8 in heavy trading.

-- "The stock went down on Monday with the news about exchange rates," Helmig said, referring to the recent strengthening of the dollar against the mark and the French franc. "The quarter is doing just fine."

-- Helmig also said that as investors become more comfortable with IBM as a diversified company, and more like a General Electric Co, as opposed to just a hardware maker, its price/earnings multiple will rise accordingly. Its current P/E ratio is about 13 times 1998 earnings estimates.
